def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",
            "on",
            "nt",
            "ha",
            "ou",
            "it",
            "hi",
            "es",
            "st",
            "en",
            "ea",
            "to",
            "or",
            "ed",
            "te",
            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:
                count += 1
        return count / max(len(words), 1)

}

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03):
    """Apply word dropout and synonym replacement to text."""
    words = str(text).split()
    augmented_words = []
    for word in words:
        # Word dropout
        if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
            continue
        # Synonym replacement
        if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
            replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
            # Preserve capitalization
            if word[0].isupper():
                replacement = replacement.capitalize()
            augmented_words.append(replacement)
        else:
            augmented_words.append(word)
    return " ".join(augmented_words)

            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

        if return_embeddings:
            features = self.feature_mlp(pooled)
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits


tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("distilbert-base-uncased")
text_encoder = TextFeatureEncoder(num_classes=num_classes).to(device)


# Dataset
class TextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, augment=False):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        if self.augment:
            text = augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03)
        encoded = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=256,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": encoded["input_ids"].squeeze(0),
            "attention_mask": encoded["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

            ],

    ],

)

)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():

        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()
        scheduler.step(epoch + num_batches / len(train_loader))
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

    text_encoder.eval()
    val_loss = 0.0
    val_num_batches = 0
    all_val_preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:

            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
            with autocast():

                )

            val_loss += loss.item()
            val_num_batches += 1

            all_val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())

    if avg_val_loss < best_val_loss:

            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):

# Prepare meta features (use only embeddings, no tabular features)

        logits = meta_net(meta_x)
        loss = meta_criterion(logits, meta_y)
        loss.backward()
        meta_optimizer.step()
        total_meta_loss += loss.item()
        num_meta_batches += 1

    meta_net.eval()
    val_meta_loss = 0.0
    val_meta_batches = 0
    all_meta_val_preds = []

    else:

nodes.code_summary: The code implements a multi-stage ensemble for author attribution. First, it loads data and creates a 5-fold stratified train/validation split. Feature engineering extracts ~40 features including text statistics, punctuation counts, stopword ratios, vocabulary diversity, historical/archaic word indicators, and n-gram densities, which are scaled using StandardScaler. Two tree-based models are trained: XGBoost and LightGBM on tabular features. A DistilBERT model with multi-head attention pooling is fine-tuned on text data with text augmentation (word dropout and synonym replacement), using cosine annealing warm restarts scheduler and mixed precision training. Text embeddings from DistilBERT are then used to train a meta-learner (a small MLP with batch normalization). The final submission blends predictions, and the validation metric is log loss (lower is better).

def extract_features(text_series, is_train=True):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=text_series.index)

    features["word_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: len(str(x).split()))
    features["sent_count"] = text_series.apply(

    )
    features["avg_word_len"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: (

        )
    )

    # Punctuation features
    features["excl_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("!"))
    features["quest_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("?"))
    features["period_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("."))
    features["comma_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count(","))
    features["semi_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count(";"))

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03):
    """Apply word dropout and synonym replacement to text."""
    words = str(text).split()
    augmented_words = []
    for word in words:
        # Word dropout
        if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
            continue
        # Synonym replacement
        if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
            replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
            # Preserve capitalization
            if word[0].isupper():
                replacement = replacement.capitalize()
            augmented_words.append(replacement)
        else:
            augmented_words.append(word)
    return " ".join(augmented_words)


# ============================================================
# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )
        self.feature_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

        if return_embeddings:
            features = self.feature_mlp(pooled)
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits

            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=256,
            return_tensors="pt",

            "attention_mask": encoded["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),
        }

## Evaluation

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

$$\text{log loss} = -\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^M y_{ij} \log(p_{ij})$$

In order to avoid the extremes of the log function, predicted probabilities are replaced with \\(max(min(p,1-10^{-15}),10^{-15})\\).

def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()

            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),

        ]
        count = 0

        return count / max(len(words), 1)

import random

# Simple synonym dictionary for augmentation
SYNONYM_MAP = {
    "good": ["fine", "excellent", "great", "superb"],
    "bad": ["poor", "terrible", "awful", "dreadful"],
    "big": ["large", "huge", "enormous", "vast"],
    "small": ["tiny", "little", "miniature", "petite"],
    "beautiful": ["lovely", "pretty", "gorgeous", "stunning"],
    "strange": ["odd", "weird", "peculiar", "bizarre"],
    "dark": ["gloomy", "shadowy", "murky", "dim"],
    "light": ["bright", "brilliant", "luminous", "radiant"],
    "happy": ["glad", "joyful", "delighted", "cheerful"],
    "sad": ["sorrowful", "gloomy", "melancholy", "dreary"],
    "old": ["ancient", "elderly", "aged", "venerable"],
    "new": ["fresh", "novel", "modern", "recent"],
    "strong": ["powerful", "robust", "sturdy", "mighty"],
    "weak": ["feeble", "fragile", "frail", "delicate"],
    "great": ["grand", "majestic", "splendid", "magnificent"],
    "little": ["slight", "minor", "trivial", "insignificant"],
    "quick": ["fast", "rapid", "swift", "speedy"],
    "slow": ["sluggish", "leisurely", "gradual", "unhurried"],
    "hard": ["difficult", "tough", "challenging", "arduous"],
    "soft": ["gentle", "tender", "mellow", "mild"],
    "thin": ["slender", "slim", "narrow", "fine"],
    "thick": ["dense", "heavy", "solid", "substantial"],
    "cold": ["chilly", "frigid", "icy", "frosty"],
    "hot": ["warm", "scorching", "blazing", "fiery"],
    "beautiful": ["lovely", "pretty", "gorgeous", "stunning", "attractive"],
    "strange": ["odd", "weird", "peculiar", "bizarre", "curious"],
}

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03):
    """Apply word dropout and synonym replacement to text."""
    words = str(text).split()
    augmented_words = []
    for word in words:
        # Word dropout
        if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
            continue
        # Synonym replacement
        if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
            replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
            # Preserve capitalization
            if word[0].isupper():
                replacement = replacement.capitalize()
            augmented_words.append(replacement)
        else:
            augmented_words.append(word)
    return " ".join(augmented_words)


# ============================================================
# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )
        self.feature_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

        if return_embeddings:
            features = self.feature_mlp(pooled)
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits


tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("distilbert-base-uncased")
text_encoder = TextFeatureEncoder(num_classes=num_classes).to(device)


# Dataset
class TextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, augment=False):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        if self.augment:
            text = augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03)
        encoded = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=256,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": encoded["input_ids"].squeeze(0),
            "attention_mask": encoded["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


train_dataset = TextDataset(train_texts, y_train, augment=True)


# train_dataset is now created above with augment=True
val_dataset = TextDataset(val_texts, y_val)
test_dataset = TextDataset(test_texts)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
)

    val_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
)

# Optimizer
optimizer = AdamW(
    [
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in text_encoder.named_parameters()
                if "classifier" in n or "feature_mlp" in n
            ],
            "lr": 1e-4,
        },
        {
            "params": [
                p
                for n, p in text_encoder.named_parameters()
                if "distilbert" in n and p.requires_grad
            ],
            "lr": 2e-5,
        },
    ],
    weight_decay=0.05,
)

scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
    optimizer, T_0=5, T_mult=2, eta_min=1e-6
)
scaler_grad = GradScaler()
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

# Training
best_val_loss = float("inf")
best_model_state = None
num_epochs = 10
patience = 3
patience_counter = 0

print("Training DistilBERT...")
for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    text_encoder.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    num_batches = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = text_encoder(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)
        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()
        scheduler.step(epoch + num_batches / len(train_loader))
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

    text_encoder.eval()
    val_loss = 0.0
    val_num_batches = 0
    all_val_preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
            with autocast():
                logits = text_encoder(
                    input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask
                )
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            val_loss += loss.item()
            val_num_batches += 1
            probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            all_val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    avg_val_loss = val_loss / val_num_batches
    val_probs_modern = np.concatenate(all_val_preds, axis=0)
    val_log_loss_modern = log_loss(y_val, val_probs_modern)
    print(

    )
    if avg_val_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = avg_val_loss
        best_model_state = text_encoder.state_dict().copy()
        patience_counter = 0
        print(f"  -> New best model (val_loss={best_val_loss:.6f})")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered after epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

if best_model_state is not None:
    text_encoder.load_state_dict(best_model_state)
    print(f"Loaded best model with val_loss={best_val_loss:.6f}")

modern_val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_modern, axis=0)

# ============================================================
# EXTRACT TEXT EMBEDDINGS FOR META-LEARNER
# ============================================================
def extract_embeddings(loader):
    text_encoder.eval()
    all_embeddings = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            with autocast():
                _, embeddings = text_encoder(
                    input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=True
                )
            all_embeddings.append(embeddings.cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(all_embeddings, axis=0)


train_embeddings = extract_embeddings(train_loader)
val_embeddings = extract_embeddings(val_loader)
test_embeddings = extract_embeddings(test_loader)


# ============================================================
# META-LEARNER
# ============================================================
class MetaNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=512, hidden_dim=64, num_classes=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


# Prepare meta features (use only embeddings, no tabular features)
meta_train_features = train_embeddings.copy()
meta_val_features = val_embeddings.copy()
meta_test_features = test_embeddings.copy()

meta_input_dim = meta_train_features.shape[1]  # 512
meta_net = MetaNet(input_dim=meta_input_dim, hidden_dim=64, num_classes=num_classes).to(device)
meta_optimizer = AdamW(meta_net.parameters(), lr=5e-4, weight_decay=0.05)
meta_criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

meta_train_dataset = torch.utils.data.TensorDataset(
    torch.tensor(meta_train_features, dtype=torch.float32),

)
meta_val_dataset = torch.utils.data.TensorDataset(

meta_train_loader = DataLoader(

)

meta_best_val_loss = float("inf")
meta_patience_counter = 0
meta_patience = 5
best_meta_state = None

print("Training meta-learner...")
for epoch in range(50):
    meta_net.train()
    total_meta_loss = 0.0
    num_meta_batches = 0
    for meta_x, meta_y in meta_train_loader:
        meta_x, meta_y = meta_x.to(device), meta_y.to(device)
        meta_optimizer.zero_grad()
        logits = meta_net(meta_x)
        loss = meta_criterion(logits, meta_y)
        loss.backward()
        meta_optimizer.step()
        total_meta_loss += loss.item()
        num_meta_batches += 1

    meta_net.eval()
    val_meta_loss = 0.0
    val_meta_batches = 0
    all_meta_val_preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for meta_x, meta_y in meta_val_loader:
            meta_x, meta_y = meta_x.to(device), meta_y.to(device)

            val_meta_loss += loss.item()

    avg_meta_val_loss = val_meta_loss / val_meta_batches

if best_meta_state is not None:

# Final predictions
meta_net.eval()
with torch.no_grad():

It begins with extensive feature engineering including text statistics, punctuation counts, readability scores, stopword analysis, vocabulary diversity, author-specific word indicators, and n-gram features. Three base models are trained: XGBoost and LightGBM on engineered tabular features, and a DistilBERT model (with multi-head attention pooling and text augmentation via word dropout/synonym replacement) on raw text. DistilBERT embeddings (512-dim) are extracted and concatenated with the 9 probability outputs from the three base models to form a 521-feature meta-representation. A final XGBoost stacking ensemble is trained on these meta-features to produce the submission.

def extract_features(text_series, is_train=True):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=text_series.index)

    # Basic text stats

def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",
            "on",
            "nt",
            "ha",
            "ou",
            "it",
            "hi",
            "es",
            "st",
            "en",
            "ea",
            "to",
            "or",
            "ed",
            "te",
            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:
                count += 1
        return count / max(len(words), 1)

# Simple synonym dictionary for augmentation
SYNONYM_MAP = {
    "good": ["fine", "excellent", "great", "superb"],

    "new": ["fresh", "novel", "modern", "recent"],
    "strong": ["powerful", "robust", "sturdy", "mighty"],

    "hot": ["warm", "scorching", "blazing", "fiery"],
    "beautiful": ["lovely", "pretty", "gorgeous", "stunning", "attractive"],
    "strange": ["odd", "weird", "peculiar", "bizarre", "curious"],
}

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05):
    """Apply enhanced augmentation: back-translation-invariant random word swaps, punctuation insertion, vowel noise, and synonym replacement."""
    # Choose exactly one augmentation randomly
    aug_choice = random.random()
    if aug_choice < 0.25:
        # (a) Back-translation-invariant random word swaps within 3-word windows at word_swap_prob probability
        words = str(text).split()
        if len(words) > 2:
            for i in range(len(words) - 1):
                if random.random() < word_swap_prob:
                    swap_window = min(3, len(words) - i)
                    swap_idx = i + random.randint(1, swap_window - 1)
                    words[i], words[swap_idx] = words[swap_idx], words[i]
        return " ".join(words)
    elif aug_choice < 0.50:
        # (b) Random insertion of punctuation at sentence boundaries at punct_insert_prob probability
        text_str = str(text)
        sentences = re.split(r'(\. )', text_str)
        if len(sentences) > 1:
            punct_choices = ['--', ';', ':', '...']
            result_parts = []
            for sent in sentences:
                if random.random() < punct_insert_prob and sent.strip():
                    punct = random.choice(punct_choices)
                    result_parts.append(sent.rstrip() + ' ' + punct + ' ')
                else:
                    result_parts.append(sent)
            return ''.join(result_parts)
        else:
            return text_str
    elif aug_choice < 0.75:
        # (c) Character-level noise: randomly replace vowel_noise_prob of vowels with other vowels
        text_str = str(text)
        vowels = 'aeiouAEIOU'
        vowel_list = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']
        result_chars = []
        for ch in text_str:
            if ch.lower() in 'aeiou' and random.random() < vowel_noise_prob:
                # Replace with random different vowel
                new_vowel = random.choice([v for v in vowel_list if v != ch.lower()])
                if ch.isupper():
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel.upper())
                else:
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel)
            else:
                result_chars.append(ch)
        return ''.join(result_chars)
    else:
        # (d) Enhanced synonym replacement at increased rate
        words = str(text).split()
        augmented_words = []
        for word in words:
            # Word dropout (keep existing behavior)
            if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
                continue
            # Enhanced synonym replacement (rate increased to 0.05)
            if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
                replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
                # Preserve capitalization
                if word[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                augmented_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                augmented_words.append(word)
        return " ".join(augmented_words)

# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )
        self.feature_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

        if return_embeddings:
            features = self.feature_mlp(pooled)
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits

# Dataset
class TextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, augment=False):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        if self.augment:
            text = augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03)
        encoded = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=256,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": encoded["input_ids"].squeeze(0),
            "attention_mask": encoded["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",
            "on",
            "nt",
            "ha",
            "ou",
            "it",
            "hi",
            "es",
            "st",
            "en",
            "ea",
            "to",
            "or",
            "ed",
            "te",
            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:
                count += 1
        return count / max(len(words), 1)

}

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03):
    """Apply word dropout and synonym replacement to text."""
    words = str(text).split()
    augmented_words = []
    for word in words:
        # Word dropout
        if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
            continue
        # Synonym replacement
        if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
            replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
            # Preserve capitalization
            if word[0].isupper():
                replacement = replacement.capitalize()
            augmented_words.append(replacement)
        else:
            augmented_words.append(word)
    return " ".join(augmented_words)

# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )
        self.feature_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

        if return_embeddings:
            features = self.feature_mlp(pooled)
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits

# Dataset
class TextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, augment=False):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        if self.augment:
            text = augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03)
        encoded = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=256,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": encoded["input_ids"].squeeze(0),
            "attention_mask": encoded["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

def extract_embeddings(loader):
    text_encoder.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)

                    input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=True

    return np.concatenate(all_embeddings, axis=0)

nodes.code_summary: The implementation uses a multi-stage approach: (1) Feature engineering extracts ~40 handcrafted text features (character/word/punctuation counts, readability metrics, archaic word indicators, n-gram densities). (2) Tabular models (XGBoost, LightGBM) are trained on these features with 5-fold cross-validation. (3) A DistilBERT-based neural network with multi-head attention pooling is fine-tuned on the raw text with data augmentation (word swaps, punctuation insertion, vowel noise, synonym replacement). (4) A stacking ensemble is built using an XGBoost meta-learner trained on 512-dim DistilBERT embeddings concatenated with probability outputs from XGBoost, LightGBM, and DistilBERT (521 features total). Log loss is the evaluation metric (lower is better).

import pandas as pd

# ============================================================

def extract_features(text_series, is_train=True):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=text_series.index)

    # Basic text stats
    features["char_count"] = text_series.apply(len)
    features["word_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: len(str(x).split()))
    features["sent_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: len(re.split(r"[.!?]+", str(x))) - 1
    )
    features["avg_word_len"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: (
            np.mean([len(w) for w in str(x).split()]) if len(str(x).split()) > 0 else 0
        )
    )

    # Punctuation features
    features["excl_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("!"))
    features["quest_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("?"))
    features["period_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("."))
    features["comma_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count(","))
    features["semi_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count(";"))
    features["colon_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count(":"))
    features["quote_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: str(x).count('"') + str(x).count("'")
    )
    features["dash_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("-"))

    # Caps and special patterns
    features["caps_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in str(x) if c.isupper())
    )
    features["caps_ratio"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in str(x) if c.isupper()) / max(len(str(x)), 1)
    )
    features["digit_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in str(x) if c.isdigit())
    )

    # Readability features
    features["syllable_est"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(
            1
            for w in str(x).split()
            for c in ["a", "e", "i", "o", "u", "y"]
            if c in w.lower()
        )
    )
    features["complex_words"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).split() if len(w) > 6)
    )

    # Quote density
    features["quote_density"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: str(x).count('"') / max(len(str(x)), 1)
    )

    # Stopword-based features
    stopwords = {
        "the",
        "a",
        "an",
        "and",
        "or",
        "but",
        "in",
        "on",
        "at",
        "to",
        "for",
        "of",
        "by",
        "with",
        "from",
        "as",
        "is",
        "was",
        "were",
        "be",
        "been",
        "have",
        "has",

        "do",
        "does",
        "did",
        "will",
        "would",
        "can",
        "could",
        "shall",
        "should",
        "may",
        "might",
        "must",
    }

    features["stopword_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in stopwords)
    )
    features["stopword_ratio"] = features["stopword_count"] / features[
        "word_count"
    ].replace(0, 1)

    # Word length distribution
    features["long_word_ratio"] = features["complex_words"] / features[
        "word_count"
    ].replace(0, 1)
    features["short_word_ratio"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).split() if len(w) <= 3)
    ) / features["word_count"].replace(0, 1)

    # Vocabulary diversity
    features["unique_words"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: len(set(str(x).lower().split()))
    )
    features["type_token_ratio"] = features["unique_words"] / features[
        "word_count"
    ].replace(0, 1)

    # Historical/archaic word indicators
    archaic_words = {
        "thee",
        "thou",
        "thy",
        "thine",
        "ye",
        "hath",
        "doth",
        "art",
        "hast",
        "whence",
        "thence",
        "hither",
        "thither",
        "whither",
        "ere",
        "nay",
        "forsooth",
        "perchance",
        "anon",
        "prithee",
    }
    lovecraft_words = {
        "eldritch",
        "cyclopean",
        "non-euclidean",
        "ichor",
        "gibbering",
        "maddening",
        "cosmic",
        "carcosa",
        "yog-sothoth",
        "cthulhu",
    }
    poe_words = {
        "nevermore",
        "chamber",
        "tapping",
        "rapping",
        "sepulchre",
        "ghoul",
        "pallid",
        "dreary",
        "weary",
        "ebony",
    }

    features["archaic_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in archaic_words)
    )
    features["lovecraft_score"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in lovecraft_words)
    )
    features["poe_score"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in poe_words)
    )

    # First person pronoun usage
    first_person = {"i", "me", "my", "mine", "myself", "we", "us", "our", "ours"}
    features["first_person_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in first_person)
    )

    # Sentence complexity
    features["avg_sent_length"] = features["word_count"] / features[
        "sent_count"
    ].replace(0, 1)

    # Character diversity
    features["unique_chars"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: len(set(str(x).lower())))
    features["char_diversity"] = features["unique_chars"] / features[
        "char_count"
    ].replace(0, 1)

    # Negation count
    negation_words = {
        "not",

    features["negation_count"] = text_series.apply(

    # Emotion/affect words

    features["positive_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in positive_words)
    )
    features["negative_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in negative_words)
    )
    features["sentiment_ratio"] = (
        features["positive_count"] - features["negative_count"]
    ) / (features["positive_count"] + features["negative_count"] + 1)

    return features


# Extract features
train_features = extract_features(train_df["text"], is_train=True)

# N-gram features
def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",
            "on",
            "nt",
            "ha",
            "ou",
            "it",
            "hi",
            "es",
            "st",
            "en",
            "ea",
            "to",
            "or",
            "ed",
            "te",
            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:
                count += 1
        return count / max(len(words), 1)


for prefix, df in [("train", train_df), ("val", val_df), ("test", test)]:

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05):
    """Apply enhanced augmentation: back-translation-invariant random word swaps, punctuation insertion, vowel noise, and synonym replacement."""
    # Choose exactly one augmentation randomly
    aug_choice = random.random()
    if aug_choice < 0.25:
        # (a) Back-translation-invariant random word swaps within 3-word windows at word_swap_prob probability
        words = str(text).split()
        if len(words) > 2:
            for i in range(len(words) - 1):
                if random.random() < word_swap_prob:
                    swap_window = min(3, len(words) - i)
                    swap_idx = i + random.randint(1, swap_window - 1)
                    words[i], words[swap_idx] = words[swap_idx], words[i]
        return " ".join(words)
    elif aug_choice < 0.50:
        # (b) Random insertion of punctuation at sentence boundaries at punct_insert_prob probability
        text_str = str(text)
        sentences = re.split(r'(\. )', text_str)
        if len(sentences) > 1:
            punct_choices = ['--', ';', ':', '...']
            result_parts = []
            for sent in sentences:
                if random.random() < punct_insert_prob and sent.strip():
                    punct = random.choice(punct_choices)
                    result_parts.append(sent.rstrip() + ' ' + punct + ' ')
                else:
                    result_parts.append(sent)
            return ''.join(result_parts)
        else:
            return text_str
    elif aug_choice < 0.75:
        # (c) Character-level noise: randomly replace vowel_noise_prob of vowels with other vowels
        text_str = str(text)
        vowels = 'aeiouAEIOU'
        vowel_list = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']
        result_chars = []
        for ch in text_str:
            if ch.lower() in 'aeiou' and random.random() < vowel_noise_prob:
                # Replace with random different vowel
                new_vowel = random.choice([v for v in vowel_list if v != ch.lower()])
                if ch.isupper():
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel.upper())
                else:
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel)
            else:
                result_chars.append(ch)
        return ''.join(result_chars)
    else:
        # (d) Enhanced synonym replacement at increased rate
        words = str(text).split()
        augmented_words = []
        for word in words:
            # Word dropout (keep existing behavior)
            if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
                continue
            # Enhanced synonym replacement (rate increased to 0.05)
            if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
                replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
                # Preserve capitalization
                if word[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                augmented_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                augmented_words.append(word)
        return " ".join(augmented_words)


# ============================================================
# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
        stylometric_dim=41,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        # Parallel stylometric encoder branch: 41 -> 64 -> 32 -> 16
        self.stylometric_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(stylometric_dim, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 16),
            nn.LayerNorm(16),
        )

        # Classifier takes concatenated BERT pooled (512) + stylometric (16) = 528
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size + 16, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )
        self.feature_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, stylometric_features=None, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

        # Process stylometric features if provided
        if stylometric_features is not None:
            stylo_emb = self.stylometric_encoder(stylometric_features)
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, stylo_emb], dim=1)
        else:
            combined = pooled

        if return_embeddings:
            features = self.feature_mlp(pooled)
            # For embeddings, still return just the text embedding (without stylometric)
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            return logits

def freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=-1):
    """Freeze DistilBERT layers. Default (-1) freezes all transformer layers."""
    distilbert = model.distilbert
    # Freeze embeddings
    for param in distilbert.embeddings.parameters():
        param.requires_grad = False
    # Freeze transformer layers based on num_layers_to_freeze
    if num_layers_to_freeze == -1:
        # Freeze all transformer layers
        for layer in distilbert.transformer.layer:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = False
    else:
        # Freeze the first (12 - num_layers_to_freeze) layers, unfreeze the rest
        total_layers = len(distilbert.transformer.layer)
        for i, layer in enumerate(distilbert.transformer.layer):
            if i < total_layers - num_layers_to_freeze:
                for param in layer.parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = False
            else:
                for param in layer.parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True

def unfreeze_next_layers(model, epoch):
    """Progressive unfreezing: unfreeze top 4 layers every 2 epochs."""
    if epoch == 2:
        # Unfreeze top 4 layers (layers 8-11 in 0-indexed)
        freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=4)
    elif epoch == 4:
        # Unfreeze next 4 layers (layers 4-7)
        freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=8)
    elif epoch == 6:
        # Unfreeze all remaining layers
        freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=12)

def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",

            "nt",

            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:

        return count / max(len(words), 1)

SYNONYM_MAP = {

}

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05):
    """Apply enhanced augmentation: back-translation-invariant random word swaps, punctuation insertion, vowel noise, and synonym replacement."""
    # Choose exactly one augmentation randomly
    aug_choice = random.random()
    if aug_choice < 0.25:
        # (a) Back-translation-invariant random word swaps within 3-word windows at word_swap_prob probability
        words = str(text).split()
        if len(words) > 2:
            for i in range(len(words) - 1):
                if random.random() < word_swap_prob:
                    swap_window = min(3, len(words) - i)
                    swap_idx = i + random.randint(1, swap_window - 1)
                    words[i], words[swap_idx] = words[swap_idx], words[i]
        return " ".join(words)
    elif aug_choice < 0.50:
        # (b) Random insertion of punctuation at sentence boundaries at punct_insert_prob probability
        text_str = str(text)
        sentences = re.split(r'(\. )', text_str)
        if len(sentences) > 1:
            punct_choices = ['--', ';', ':', '...']
            result_parts = []
            for sent in sentences:
                if random.random() < punct_insert_prob and sent.strip():
                    punct = random.choice(punct_choices)
                    result_parts.append(sent.rstrip() + ' ' + punct + ' ')
                else:
                    result_parts.append(sent)
            return ''.join(result_parts)
        else:
            return text_str
    elif aug_choice < 0.75:
        # (c) Character-level noise: randomly replace vowel_noise_prob of vowels with other vowels
        text_str = str(text)
        vowels = 'aeiouAEIOU'
        vowel_list = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']
        result_chars = []
        for ch in text_str:
            if ch.lower() in 'aeiou' and random.random() < vowel_noise_prob:
                # Replace with random different vowel
                new_vowel = random.choice([v for v in vowel_list if v != ch.lower()])
                if ch.isupper():
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel.upper())
                else:
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel)
            else:
                result_chars.append(ch)
        return ''.join(result_chars)
    else:
        # (d) Enhanced synonym replacement at increased rate
        words = str(text).split()
        augmented_words = []
        for word in words:
            # Word dropout (keep existing behavior)
            if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
                continue
            # Enhanced synonym replacement (rate increased to 0.05)
            if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
                replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
                # Preserve capitalization
                if word[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                augmented_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                augmented_words.append(word)
        return " ".join(augmented_words)

# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )
        self.feature_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)

        if return_embeddings:
            features = self.feature_mlp(pooled)
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits

It then trains XGBoost and LightGBM classifiers on these features. A DistilBERT model with multi-head attention pooling and a stylometric encoder branch is used for text classification, with progressive unfreezing and linear LR decay. However, the classifier's input dimension (768+16=784) is hardcoded, causing a crash when stylometric features are not provided (falling back to just 768-dim BERT output). The final ensemble stacks base model probabilities with DistilBERT embeddings into a meta XGBoost classifier.

def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",

            "at",

            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:
                count += 1
        return count / max(len(words), 1)

    "strange": ["odd", "weird", "peculiar", "bizarre", "curious"],
}

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05):
    """Apply enhanced augmentation: back-translation-invariant random word swaps, punctuation insertion, vowel noise, and synonym replacement."""
    # Choose exactly one augmentation randomly
    aug_choice = random.random()
    if aug_choice < 0.25:
        # (a) Back-translation-invariant random word swaps within 3-word windows at word_swap_prob probability
        words = str(text).split()
        if len(words) > 2:
            for i in range(len(words) - 1):
                if random.random() < word_swap_prob:
                    swap_window = min(3, len(words) - i)
                    swap_idx = i + random.randint(1, swap_window - 1)
                    words[i], words[swap_idx] = words[swap_idx], words[i]
        return " ".join(words)
    elif aug_choice < 0.50:
        # (b) Random insertion of punctuation at sentence boundaries at punct_insert_prob probability
        text_str = str(text)
        sentences = re.split(r'(\. )', text_str)
        if len(sentences) > 1:
            punct_choices = ['--', ';', ':', '...']
            result_parts = []
            for sent in sentences:
                if random.random() < punct_insert_prob and sent.strip():
                    punct = random.choice(punct_choices)
                    result_parts.append(sent.rstrip() + ' ' + punct + ' ')
                else:
                    result_parts.append(sent)
            return ''.join(result_parts)
        else:
            return text_str
    elif aug_choice < 0.75:
        # (c) Character-level noise: randomly replace vowel_noise_prob of vowels with other vowels
        text_str = str(text)
        vowels = 'aeiouAEIOU'
        vowel_list = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']
        result_chars = []
        for ch in text_str:
            if ch.lower() in 'aeiou' and random.random() < vowel_noise_prob:
                # Replace with random different vowel
                new_vowel = random.choice([v for v in vowel_list if v != ch.lower()])
                if ch.isupper():
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel.upper())
                else:
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel)
            else:
                result_chars.append(ch)
        return ''.join(result_chars)
    else:
        # (d) Enhanced synonym replacement at increased rate
        words = str(text).split()
        augmented_words = []
        for word in words:
            # Word dropout (keep existing behavior)
            if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
                continue
            # Enhanced synonym replacement (rate increased to 0.05)
            if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
                replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
                # Preserve capitalization
                if word[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                augmented_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                augmented_words.append(word)
        return " ".join(augmented_words)

# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
        stylometric_dim=41,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        # Parallel stylometric encoder branch: 41 -> 64 -> 32 -> 16
        self.stylometric_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(stylometric_dim, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 16),
            nn.LayerNorm(16),
        )

        # Classifier takes concatenated BERT pooled (768) + stylometric (16) = 784
        # When stylometric features are not provided, use only BERT pooled (768)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )
        # Separate branch for when stylometric features are available
        self.stylo_projection = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size + 16, self.hidden_size)
        self.feature_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, stylometric_features=None, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size=768)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size=768)

        # Process stylometric features if provided
        if stylometric_features is not None:
            stylo_emb = self.stylometric_encoder(stylometric_features)  # (batch, 16)
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, stylo_emb], dim=1)  # (batch, 768+16=784)
            combined = self.stylo_projection(combined)  # project back to (batch, 768)
        else:
            combined = pooled  # (batch, 768)

        if return_embeddings:
            features = self.feature_mlp(pooled)
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            return logits

class TextDataset(Dataset):

        self.texts = texts

        }
        if self.labels is not None:

# Progressive unfreezing setup
def freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=-1):
    """Freeze DistilBERT layers. Default (-1) freezes all transformer layers."""
    distilbert = model.distilbert
    # Freeze embeddings
    for param in distilbert.embeddings.parameters():
        param.requires_grad = False
    # Freeze transformer layers based on num_layers_to_freeze
    if num_layers_to_freeze == -1:
        # Freeze all transformer layers
        for layer in distilbert.transformer.layer:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = False
    else:
        # Freeze the first (12 - num_layers_to_freeze) layers, unfreeze the rest
        total_layers = len(distilbert.transformer.layer)
        for i, layer in enumerate(distilbert.transformer.layer):
            if i < total_layers - num_layers_to_freeze:
                for param in layer.parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = False
            else:
                for param in layer.parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True

def unfreeze_next_layers(model, epoch):
    """Progressive unfreezing: unfreeze top 4 layers every 2 epochs."""
    if epoch == 2:
        # Unfreeze top 4 layers (layers 8-11 in 0-indexed)
        freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=4)
    elif epoch == 4:
        # Unfreeze next 4 layers (layers 4-7)
        freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=8)
    elif epoch == 6:
        # Unfreeze all remaining layers
        freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=12)

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=text_series.index)

    # Basic text stats
    features["char_count"] = text_series.apply(len)
    features["word_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: len(str(x).split()))
    features["sent_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: len(re.split(r"[.!?]+", str(x))) - 1
    )
    features["avg_word_len"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: (
            np.mean([len(w) for w in str(x).split()]) if len(str(x).split()) > 0 else 0
        )
    )

    # Punctuation features
    features["excl_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("!"))
    features["quest_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("?"))
    features["period_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("."))
    features["comma_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count(","))
    features["semi_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count(";"))
    features["colon_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count(":"))
    features["quote_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: str(x).count('"') + str(x).count("'")
    )
    features["dash_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("-"))

    # Caps and special patterns
    features["caps_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in str(x) if c.isupper())
    )
    features["caps_ratio"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in str(x) if c.isupper()) / max(len(str(x)), 1)
    )
    features["digit_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in str(x) if c.isdigit())
    )

    # Readability features
    features["syllable_est"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(
            1
            for w in str(x).split()
            for c in ["a", "e", "i", "o", "u", "y"]
            if c in w.lower()
        )
    )
    features["complex_words"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).split() if len(w) > 6)
    )

    # Quote density
    features["quote_density"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: str(x).count('"') / max(len(str(x)), 1)
    )

    # Stopword-based features
    stopwords = {
        "the",
        "a",
        "an",
        "and",
        "or",
        "but",
        "in",
        "on",
        "at",
        "to",
        "for",
        "of",

        "would",
        "can",
        "could",
        "shall",
        "should",
        "may",
        "might",
        "must",
    }

    features["stopword_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in stopwords)
    )
    features["stopword_ratio"] = features["stopword_count"] / features[
        "word_count"
    ].replace(0, 1)

    # Word length distribution
    features["long_word_ratio"] = features["complex_words"] / features[
        "word_count"
    ].replace(0, 1)
    features["short_word_ratio"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).split() if len(w) <= 3)
    ) / features["word_count"].replace(0, 1)

    # Vocabulary diversity
    features["unique_words"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: len(set(str(x).lower().split()))
    )
    features["type_token_ratio"] = features["unique_words"] / features[
        "word_count"
    ].replace(0, 1)

    # Historical/archaic word indicators
    archaic_words = {

    features["lovecraft_score"] = text_series.apply(

    # First person pronoun usage
    first_person = {"i", "me", "my", "mine", "myself", "we", "us", "our", "ours"}
    features["first_person_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in first_person)

    # Sentence complexity
    features["avg_sent_length"] = features["word_count"] / features[

    features["unique_chars"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: len(set(str(x).lower())))
    features["char_diversity"] = features["unique_chars"] / features[
        "char_count"
    ].replace(0, 1)

    # Negation count
    negation_words = {

    }
    features["negation_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in negation_words)

    # Emotion/affect words
    positive_words = set(
        [
            "love",

            "joy",
            "delight",
            "pleasure",

        ]
    )

    features["positive_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in positive_words)
    )
    features["negative_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in negative_words)
    )
    features["sentiment_ratio"] = (
        features["positive_count"] - features["negative_count"]
    ) / (features["positive_count"] + features["negative_count"] + 1)

    return features

# N-gram features
def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",
            "on",
            "nt",
            "ha",
            "ou",
            "it",
            "hi",
            "es",
            "st",
            "en",
            "ea",
            "to",
            "or",
            "ed",
            "te",
            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:
                count += 1
        return count / max(len(words), 1)

import random

# Simple synonym dictionary for augmentation
SYNONYM_MAP = {
    "good": ["fine", "excellent", "great", "superb"],
    "bad": ["poor", "terrible", "awful", "dreadful"],
    "big": ["large", "huge", "enormous", "vast"],

    "beautiful": ["lovely", "pretty", "gorgeous", "stunning"],
