# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
        stylometric_dim=41,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        # Parallel stylometric encoder branch: 41 -> 64 -> 32 -> 16
        self.stylometric_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(stylometric_dim, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 16),
            nn.LayerNorm(16),
        )

        # Classifier takes concatenated BERT pooled (768) + stylometric (16) = 784
        # When stylometric features are not provided, use only BERT pooled (768)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )
        # Separate branch for when stylometric features are available
        self.stylo_projection = nn.Linear(self.hidden_size + 16, self.hidden_size)
        self.feature_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, stylometric_features=None, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size=768)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size=768)

        # Process stylometric features if provided
        if stylometric_features is not None:
            stylo_emb = self.stylometric_encoder(stylometric_features)  # (batch, 16)
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, stylo_emb], dim=1)  # (batch, 768+16=784)
            combined = self.stylo_projection(combined)  # project back to (batch, 768)
        else:
            combined = pooled  # (batch, 768)

        if return_embeddings:
            features = self.feature_mlp(pooled)
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            return logits


tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("distilbert-base-uncased")
text_encoder = TextFeatureEncoder(num_classes=num_classes).to(device)


# Dataset
class TextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, augment=False):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        if self.augment:
            text = augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03)
        encoded = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=256,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": encoded["input_ids"].squeeze(0),
            "attention_mask": encoded["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


train_dataset = TextDataset(train_texts, y_train, augment=True)


# train_dataset is now created above with augment=True
val_dataset = TextDataset(val_texts, y_val)
test_dataset = TextDataset(test_texts)

    train_dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
)

)

# Progressive unfreezing setup
def freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=-1):
    """Freeze DistilBERT layers. Default (-1) freezes all transformer layers."""
    distilbert = model.distilbert
    # Freeze embeddings
    for param in distilbert.embeddings.parameters():
        param.requires_grad = False
    # Freeze transformer layers based on num_layers_to_freeze
    if num_layers_to_freeze == -1:
        # Freeze all transformer layers
        for layer in distilbert.transformer.layer:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = False
    else:
        # Freeze the first (12 - num_layers_to_freeze) layers, unfreeze the rest
        total_layers = len(distilbert.transformer.layer)
        for i, layer in enumerate(distilbert.transformer.layer):
            if i < total_layers - num_layers_to_freeze:
                for param in layer.parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = False
            else:
                for param in layer.parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True

def unfreeze_next_layers(model, epoch):
    """Progressive unfreezing: unfreeze top 4 layers every 2 epochs."""
    if epoch == 2:
        # Unfreeze top 4 layers (layers 8-11 in 0-indexed)
        freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=4)
    elif epoch == 4:
        # Unfreeze next 4 layers (layers 4-7)
        freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=8)
    elif epoch == 6:
        # Unfreeze all remaining layers
        freeze_bert_layers(model, num_layers_to_freeze=12)

# Initialize: freeze all DistilBERT layers (only classifier and attention pooling trainable)
freeze_bert_layers(text_encoder, num_layers_to_freeze=-1)

# Use a single parameter group with AdamW to avoid complex param group reconstruction issues
optimizer = AdamW(
    text_encoder.parameters(),
    lr=5e-5,
    weight_decay=0.05,
)

# Linear decay scheduler
def linear_decay(epoch, num_epochs):
    return 1.0 - (epoch / num_epochs)

scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(
    optimizer, lr_lambda=lambda epoch: linear_decay(epoch, num_epochs=10)
)
scaler = GradScaler()
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

# Training

best_model_state = None

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    # Apply progressive unfreezing according to schedule
    unfreeze_next_layers(text_encoder, epoch)

    # Rebuild optimizer to include newly unfrozen layers
    if epoch > 0 and epoch % 2 == 0:
        # Create fresh optimizer with current parameters (newly unfrozen layers now require grad)
        optimizer = AdamW(
            text_encoder.parameters(),
            lr=5e-5,
            weight_decay=0.05,
        )
        # Rebuild scheduler for the new optimizer
        scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(
            optimizer, lr_lambda=lambda epoch: linear_decay(epoch, num_epochs=10)
        )
        # Also create a fresh scaler
        scaler = GradScaler()

    text_encoder.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    num_batches = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = text_encoder(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, stylometric_features=None)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1
    # Step scheduler after epoch
    scheduler.step()
    avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

    text_encoder.eval()
    val_loss = 0.0
    val_num_batches = 0
    all_val_preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
            with autocast():
                logits = text_encoder(
                    input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, stylometric_features=None
                )
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            val_loss += loss.item()
            val_num_batches += 1
            probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            all_val_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    avg_val_loss = val_loss / val_num_batches
    val_probs_modern = np.concatenate(all_val_preds, axis=0)
    val_log_loss_modern = log_loss(y_val, val_probs_modern)
    print(

    )
    if avg_val_loss < best_val_loss:

# Generate predictions

def extract_embeddings(loader):

    with torch.no_grad():

            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            with autocast():
                _, embeddings = text_encoder(
                    input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=True
                )
            all_embeddings.append(embeddings.cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(all_embeddings, axis=0)


train_embeddings = extract_embeddings(train_loader)

train_distilbert_probs = np.concatenate(all_train_probs, axis=0)

# Rebuild stacking features correctly
X_train_meta = np.concatenate([

    xgb_model.predict_proba(X_train_tab),  # 3-dim
    lgb_model.predict_proba(X_train_tab),  # 3-dim

], axis=1)

# Train stacking XGBoost model
print("Training stacking XGBoost ensemble...")
stacking_model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,

)

score = log_loss(y_val, val_probs_final)
print(f"Stacking Ensemble Validation Log Loss: {score:.6f}")

# Clip and normalize
eps = 1e-15
test_probs_final = np.clip(test_probs_final, eps, 1 - eps)
test_probs_final = test_probs_final / test_probs_final.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# Create submission

submission = pd.DataFrame(

print(f"Test predictions shape: {submission.shape}")
print(submission.head())

    features["sentiment_ratio"] = (

# N-gram features
def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",
            "on",
            "nt",
            "ha",
            "ou",
            "it",
            "hi",
            "es",
            "st",
            "en",
            "ea",
            "to",
            "or",
            "ed",
            "te",
            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:
                count += 1
        return count / max(len(words), 1)

    "strange": ["odd", "weird", "peculiar", "bizarre", "curious"],
}

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.05, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05):
    """Apply enhanced augmentation: one of four augmentation types chosen randomly with equal probability."""
    # Choose exactly one augmentation randomly with equal probability (0.25 each)
    aug_choice = random.random()
    if aug_choice < 0.25:
        # (a) Random word swaps within 3-word windows
        words = str(text).split()
        if len(words) > 2:
            for i in range(len(words) - 1):
                if random.random() < word_swap_prob:
                    swap_window = min(3, len(words) - i)
                    swap_idx = i + random.randint(1, swap_window - 1)
                    words[i], words[swap_idx] = words[swap_idx], words[i]
        return " ".join(words)
    elif aug_choice < 0.50:
        # (b) Random insertion of punctuation at sentence boundaries
        text_str = str(text)
        sentences = re.split(r'(\. )', text_str)
        if len(sentences) > 1:
            punct_choices = ['--', ';', ':', '...']
            result_parts = []
            for sent in sentences:
                if random.random() < punct_insert_prob and sent.strip():
                    punct = random.choice(punct_choices)
                    result_parts.append(sent.rstrip() + ' ' + punct + ' ')
                else:
                    result_parts.append(sent)
            return ''.join(result_parts)
        else:
            return text_str
    elif aug_choice < 0.75:
        # (c) Character-level noise: randomly replace vowels with other vowels
        text_str = str(text)
        vowel_list = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']
        result_chars = []
        for ch in text_str:
            if ch.lower() in 'aeiou' and random.random() < vowel_noise_prob:
                new_vowel = random.choice([v for v in vowel_list if v != ch.lower()])
                if ch.isupper():
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel.upper())
                else:
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel)
            else:
                result_chars.append(ch)
        return ''.join(result_chars)
    else:
        # (d) Word dropout and enhanced synonym replacement
        words = str(text).split()
        augmented_words = []
        for word in words:
            if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
                continue
            if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
                replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
                if word[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                augmented_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                augmented_words.append(word)
        return " ".join(augmented_words)

# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
        stylometric_dim=41,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        # Parallel stylometric encoder: 3-layer MLP (41→64→32→16)
        self.stylometric_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(stylometric_dim, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 16),
        )

        # Classifier takes BERT pooled (768) + stylometric (16) = 784
        combined_dim = self.hidden_size + 16
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(combined_dim, self.hidden_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )

    def freeze_bert_except_top_n(self, n_layers_to_unfreeze=0):
        """Freeze all DistilBERT layers except the top n layers."""
        # First freeze everything
        for param in self.distilbert.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        # Unfreeze top n layers (transformer layers are in reverse order in distilbert)
        if n_layers_to_unfreeze > 0:
            layers = self.distilbert.transformer.layer
            total_layers = len(layers)
            for i in range(total_layers - n_layers_to_unfreeze, total_layers):
                for param in layers[i].parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, stylometric_features=None, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size=768)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size=768)

        # Process stylometric features if provided
        if stylometric_features is not None:
            stylo_emb = self.stylometric_encoder(stylometric_features)  # (batch, 16)
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, stylo_emb], dim=1)  # (batch, 768+16=784)
        else:
            # Pad with zeros if no stylometric features
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, torch.zeros(pooled.size(0), 16, device=pooled.device)], dim=1)

        if return_embeddings:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            features = combined
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            return logits

# Dataset
class TextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, augment=False):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        if self.augment:
            text = augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.05, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05)
        encoded = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=256,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": encoded["input_ids"].squeeze(0),
            "attention_mask": encoded["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),
            "idx": idx,  # Add index for mapping to stylometric features
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

# Linear decay scheduler: multiplies base lr by (1 - epoch/num_epochs)
def linear_lr(epoch, num_epochs=10):
    return max(0.0, 1.0 - epoch / num_epochs)

scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(

)

# Helper function to unfreeze next layers and add to optimizer
def unfreeze_next_layers(optimizer, text_encoder, num_layers_to_unfreeze=4):
    """Unfreeze top num_layers_to_unfreeze DistilBERT layers and add them as a new param group."""
    total_layers = len(text_encoder.distilbert.transformer.layer)
    # Calculate which layers to unfreeze (top layers)
    frozen_layers = []
    for i, layer in enumerate(text_encoder.distilbert.transformer.layer):
        if not any(p.requires_grad for p in layer.parameters()):
            frozen_layers.append(i)
    # Unfreeze the topmost frozen layers
    layers_to_unfreeze = frozen_layers[-num_layers_to_unfreeze:] if len(frozen_layers) >= num_layers_to_unfreeze else frozen_layers
    for idx in layers_to_unfreeze:
        for param in text_encoder.distilbert.transformer.layer[idx].parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
    # Add new param group for unfrozen layers with lr=5e-5
    # Collect newly unfrozen parameters
    new_params = []
    for idx in layers_to_unfreeze:
        for param in text_encoder.distilbert.transformer.layer[idx].parameters():
            new_params.append(param)
    if new_params:
        optimizer.add_param_group({'params': new_params, 'lr': 5e-5})
    return optimizer

# Training

print("Training DistilBERT with progressive unfreezing and linear decay scheduler...")
for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    # Progressive unfreezing: after 2 epochs, unfreeze top 4 layers; after 4, next 4
    if epoch == 2:
        print("Unfreezing top 4 DistilBERT layers...")
        optimizer = unfreeze_next_layers(optimizer, text_encoder, 4)
        # Set lower learning rate for previously unfrozen layers (now lower layers)
        for i, group in enumerate(optimizer.param_groups):
            if i > 0:  # First group is classifier/pooling, rest are BERT layers
                if group['lr'] == 5e-5:
                    group['lr'] = 5e-6
    elif epoch == 4:
        print("Unfreezing next 4 DistilBERT layers...")
        optimizer = unfreeze_next_layers(optimizer, text_encoder, 4)
        # Set lower learning rate for previously unfrozen layers
        for i, group in enumerate(optimizer.param_groups):
            if i > 0:
                if group['lr'] == 5e-5:
                    group['lr'] = 5e-6

    text_encoder.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    num_batches = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        # Convert stylometric features to tensor using batch indices
        stylo_batch = torch.tensor(X_train_tab[batch["idx"].cpu().numpy()], dtype=torch.float32).to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = text_encoder(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, stylometric_features=stylo_batch)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1
    scheduler.step()
    avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches

    text_encoder.eval()
    val_loss = 0.0
    val_num_batches = 0
    all_val_preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:

def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",
            "on",
            "nt",
            "ha",

            "ed",
            "te",
            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:
                count += 1
        return count / max(len(words), 1)

    "beautiful": ["lovely", "pretty", "gorgeous", "stunning", "attractive"],
    "strange": ["odd", "weird", "peculiar", "bizarre", "curious"],
}

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05):
    """Apply enhanced augmentation: back-translation-invariant random word swaps, punctuation insertion, vowel noise, and synonym replacement."""
    # Choose exactly one augmentation randomly
    aug_choice = random.random()
    if aug_choice < 0.25:
        # (a) Back-translation-invariant random word swaps within 3-word windows at word_swap_prob probability
        words = str(text).split()
        if len(words) > 2:
            for i in range(len(words) - 1):
                if random.random() < word_swap_prob:
                    swap_window = min(3, len(words) - i)
                    swap_idx = i + random.randint(1, swap_window - 1)
                    words[i], words[swap_idx] = words[swap_idx], words[i]
        return " ".join(words)
    elif aug_choice < 0.50:
        # (b) Random insertion of punctuation at sentence boundaries at punct_insert_prob probability
        text_str = str(text)
        sentences = re.split(r'(\. )', text_str)
        if len(sentences) > 1:
            punct_choices = ['--', ';', ':', '...']
            result_parts = []
            for sent in sentences:
                if random.random() < punct_insert_prob and sent.strip():
                    punct = random.choice(punct_choices)
                    result_parts.append(sent.rstrip() + ' ' + punct + ' ')
                else:
                    result_parts.append(sent)
            return ''.join(result_parts)
        else:
            return text_str
    elif aug_choice < 0.75:
        # (c) Character-level noise: randomly replace vowel_noise_prob of vowels with other vowels
        text_str = str(text)
        vowels = 'aeiouAEIOU'
        vowel_list = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']
        result_chars = []
        for ch in text_str:
            if ch.lower() in 'aeiou' and random.random() < vowel_noise_prob:
                # Replace with random different vowel
                new_vowel = random.choice([v for v in vowel_list if v != ch.lower()])
                if ch.isupper():
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel.upper())
                else:
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel)
            else:
                result_chars.append(ch)
        return ''.join(result_chars)
    else:
        # (d) Enhanced synonym replacement at increased rate
        words = str(text).split()
        augmented_words = []
        for word in words:
            # Word dropout (keep existing behavior)
            if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
                continue
            # Enhanced synonym replacement (rate increased to 0.05)
            if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
                replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
                # Preserve capitalization
                if word[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                augmented_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                augmented_words.append(word)
        return " ".join(augmented_words)

# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        # Classifier takes BERT pooled (768)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, stylometric_features=None, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size=768)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size=768)

        if return_embeddings:
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            features = pooled
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(pooled)
            return logits

class TextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, augment=False):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        if self.augment:
            text = augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.03)
        encoded = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=256,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": encoded["input_ids"].squeeze(0),
            "attention_mask": encoded["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

import random

# Simple synonym dictionary for augmentation
SYNONYM_MAP = {
    "good": ["fine", "excellent", "great", "superb"],
    "bad": ["poor", "terrible", "awful", "dreadful"],
    "big": ["large", "huge", "enormous", "vast"],

    "light": ["bright", "brilliant", "luminous", "radiant"],
    "happy": ["glad", "joyful", "delighted", "cheerful"],
    "sad": ["sorrowful", "gloomy", "melancholy", "dreary"],
    "old": ["ancient", "elderly", "aged", "venerable"],
    "new": ["fresh", "novel", "modern", "recent"],
    "strong": ["powerful", "robust", "sturdy", "mighty"],
    "weak": ["feeble", "fragile", "frail", "delicate"],
    "great": ["grand", "majestic", "splendid", "magnificent"],
    "little": ["slight", "minor", "trivial", "insignificant"],
    "quick": ["fast", "rapid", "swift", "speedy"],
    "slow": ["sluggish", "leisurely", "gradual", "unhurried"],
    "hard": ["difficult", "tough", "challenging", "arduous"],
    "soft": ["gentle", "tender", "mellow", "mild"],
    "thin": ["slender", "slim", "narrow", "fine"],
    "thick": ["dense", "heavy", "solid", "substantial"],
    "cold": ["chilly", "frigid", "icy", "frosty"],
    "hot": ["warm", "scorching", "blazing", "fiery"],
    "beautiful": ["lovely", "pretty", "gorgeous", "stunning", "attractive"],
    "strange": ["odd", "weird", "peculiar", "bizarre", "curious"],
}

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.05, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05):
    """Apply enhanced augmentation: one of four augmentation types chosen randomly with equal probability."""
    # Choose exactly one augmentation randomly with equal probability (0.25 each)
    aug_choice = random.random()
    if aug_choice < 0.25:
        # (a) Random word swaps within 3-word windows
        words = str(text).split()
        if len(words) > 2:
            for i in range(len(words) - 1):
                if random.random() < word_swap_prob:
                    swap_window = min(3, len(words) - i)
                    swap_idx = i + random.randint(1, swap_window - 1)
                    words[i], words[swap_idx] = words[swap_idx], words[i]
        return " ".join(words)
    elif aug_choice < 0.50:
        # (b) Random insertion of punctuation at sentence boundaries
        text_str = str(text)
        sentences = re.split(r'(\. )', text_str)
        if len(sentences) > 1:
            punct_choices = ['--', ';', ':', '...']
            result_parts = []
            for sent in sentences:
                if random.random() < punct_insert_prob and sent.strip():
                    punct = random.choice(punct_choices)
                    result_parts.append(sent.rstrip() + ' ' + punct + ' ')
                else:
                    result_parts.append(sent)
            return ''.join(result_parts)
        else:
            return text_str
    elif aug_choice < 0.75:
        # (c) Character-level noise: randomly replace vowels with other vowels
        text_str = str(text)
        vowel_list = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']
        result_chars = []
        for ch in text_str:
            if ch.lower() in 'aeiou' and random.random() < vowel_noise_prob:
                new_vowel = random.choice([v for v in vowel_list if v != ch.lower()])
                if ch.isupper():
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel.upper())
                else:
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel)
            else:
                result_chars.append(ch)
        return ''.join(result_chars)
    else:
        # (d) Word dropout and enhanced synonym replacement
        words = str(text).split()
        augmented_words = []
        for word in words:
            if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
                continue
            if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
                replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
                if word[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                augmented_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                augmented_words.append(word)
        return " ".join(augmented_words)

class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):

        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        # Will be properly initialized later when we know stylometric_dim
        self.stylometric_dim = stylometric_dim
        self.stylometric_encoder = None

        # Classifier takes BERT pooled (768) + stylometric (16) = 784
        combined_dim = self.hidden_size + 16
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(combined_dim, self.hidden_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )

    def freeze_bert_except_top_n(self, n_layers_to_unfreeze=0):
        """Freeze all DistilBERT layers except the top n layers."""
        # First freeze everything
        for param in self.distilbert.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        # Unfreeze top n layers (transformer layers are in reverse order in distilbert)
        if n_layers_to_unfreeze > 0:
            layers = self.distilbert.transformer.layer
            total_layers = len(layers)
            for i in range(total_layers - n_layers_to_unfreeze, total_layers):
                for param in layers[i].parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True

    def initialize_stylometric_encoder(self, stylometric_dim):
        """Initialize the stylometric encoder after knowing the correct dimension."""
        self.stylometric_dim = stylometric_dim
        self.stylometric_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(stylometric_dim, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 16),
        ).to(device)
        self._initialized = True

    _initialized = False

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, stylometric_features=None, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size=768)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size=768)

        # Process stylometric features if provided
        if stylometric_features is not None:
            if not self._initialized:
                self.initialize_stylometric_encoder(stylometric_features.size(1))
            stylo_emb = self.stylometric_encoder(stylometric_features)  # (batch, 16)
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, stylo_emb], dim=1)  # (batch, 768+16=784)
        else:
            # Pad with zeros if no stylometric features
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, torch.zeros(pooled.size(0), 16, device=pooled.device)], dim=1)

        if return_embeddings:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            features = combined
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            return logits

def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",

            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:

        return count / max(len(words), 1)

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.05, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05):

                    swap_window = min(3, len(words) - i)

                    words[i], words[swap_idx] = words[swap_idx], words[i]
        return " ".join(words)

        text_str = str(text)

            punct_choices = ['--', ';', ':', '...']
            result_parts = []
            for sent in sentences:
                if random.random() < punct_insert_prob and sent.strip():
                    punct = random.choice(punct_choices)
                    result_parts.append(sent.rstrip() + ' ' + punct + ' ')
                else:
                    result_parts.append(sent)
            return ''.join(result_parts)

                if ch.isupper():

                else:

            else:

        return ''.join(result_chars)
    else:
        # (d) Word dropout and enhanced synonym replacement
        words = str(text).split()
        augmented_words = []
        for word in words:
            if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
                continue
            if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
                replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
                if word[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                augmented_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                augmented_words.append(word)
        return " ".join(augmented_words)

# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
        stylometric_dim=41,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        # Parallel stylometric encoder: 3-layer MLP (41→64→32→16)
        self.stylometric_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(stylometric_dim, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 16),
        )

        # Classifier takes BERT pooled (768) + stylometric (16) = 784
        combined_dim = self.hidden_size + 16
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(combined_dim, self.hidden_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )

    def freeze_bert_except_top_n(self, n_layers_to_unfreeze=0):
        """Freeze all DistilBERT layers except the top n layers."""
        # First freeze everything
        for param in self.distilbert.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        # Unfreeze top n layers (transformer layers are in reverse order in distilbert)
        if n_layers_to_unfreeze > 0:
            layers = self.distilbert.transformer.layer
            total_layers = len(layers)
            for i in range(total_layers - n_layers_to_unfreeze, total_layers):
                for param in layers[i].parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, stylometric_features=None, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size=768)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size=768)

        # Process stylometric features if provided
        if stylometric_features is not None:
            stylo_emb = self.stylometric_encoder(stylometric_features)  # (batch, 16)
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, stylo_emb], dim=1)  # (batch, 768+16=784)
        else:
            # Pad with zeros if no stylometric features
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, torch.zeros(pooled.size(0), 16, device=pooled.device)], dim=1)

        if return_embeddings:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            features = combined
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            return logits

def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",
            "on",
            "nt",
            "ha",
            "ou",
            "it",
            "hi",
            "es",
            "st",
            "en",

            "ed",
            "te",
            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:
                count += 1
        return count / max(len(words), 1)

    "old": ["ancient", "elderly", "aged", "venerable"],
    "new": ["fresh", "novel", "modern", "recent"],
    "strong": ["powerful", "robust", "sturdy", "mighty"],
    "weak": ["feeble", "fragile", "frail", "delicate"],
    "great": ["grand", "majestic", "splendid", "magnificent"],

    "beautiful": ["lovely", "pretty", "gorgeous", "stunning", "attractive"],
    "strange": ["odd", "weird", "peculiar", "bizarre", "curious"],
}

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.05, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05):
    """Apply enhanced augmentation: one of four augmentation types chosen randomly with equal probability."""
    # Choose exactly one augmentation randomly with equal probability (0.25 each)
    aug_choice = random.random()
    if aug_choice < 0.25:
        # (a) Random word swaps within 3-word windows
        words = str(text).split()
        if len(words) > 2:
            for i in range(len(words) - 1):
                if random.random() < word_swap_prob:
                    swap_window = min(3, len(words) - i)
                    swap_idx = i + random.randint(1, swap_window - 1)
                    words[i], words[swap_idx] = words[swap_idx], words[i]
        return " ".join(words)
    elif aug_choice < 0.50:
        # (b) Random insertion of punctuation at sentence boundaries
        text_str = str(text)
        sentences = re.split(r'(\. )', text_str)
        if len(sentences) > 1:
            punct_choices = ['--', ';', ':', '...']
            result_parts = []
            for sent in sentences:
                if random.random() < punct_insert_prob and sent.strip():
                    punct = random.choice(punct_choices)
                    result_parts.append(sent.rstrip() + ' ' + punct + ' ')
                else:
                    result_parts.append(sent)
            return ''.join(result_parts)
        else:
            return text_str
    elif aug_choice < 0.75:
        # (c) Character-level noise: randomly replace vowels with other vowels
        text_str = str(text)
        vowel_list = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']
        result_chars = []
        for ch in text_str:
            if ch.lower() in 'aeiou' and random.random() < vowel_noise_prob:
                new_vowel = random.choice([v for v in vowel_list if v != ch.lower()])
                if ch.isupper():
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel.upper())
                else:
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel)
            else:
                result_chars.append(ch)
        return ''.join(result_chars)
    else:
        # (d) Word dropout and enhanced synonym replacement
        words = str(text).split()
        augmented_words = []
        for word in words:
            if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
                continue
            if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
                replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
                if word[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                augmented_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                augmented_words.append(word)
        return " ".join(augmented_words)

# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
        stylometric_dim=41,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        # Parallel stylometric encoder: 3-layer MLP (stylometric_dim→64→32→16)
        # Will be properly initialized later when we know stylometric_dim
        self.stylometric_dim = stylometric_dim
        self.stylometric_encoder = None

        # Classifier takes BERT pooled (768) + stylometric (16) = 784
        combined_dim = self.hidden_size + 16
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(combined_dim, self.hidden_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )

    def freeze_bert_except_top_n(self, n_layers_to_unfreeze=0):
        """Freeze all DistilBERT layers except the top n layers."""
        # First freeze everything
        for param in self.distilbert.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        # Unfreeze top n layers (transformer layers are in reverse order in distilbert)
        if n_layers_to_unfreeze > 0:
            layers = self.distilbert.transformer.layer
            total_layers = len(layers)
            for i in range(total_layers - n_layers_to_unfreeze, total_layers):
                for param in layers[i].parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True

    def initialize_stylometric_encoder(self, stylometric_dim):
        """Initialize the stylometric encoder after knowing the correct dimension."""
        self.stylometric_dim = stylometric_dim
        self.stylometric_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(stylometric_dim, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 16),
        ).to(device)
        self._initialized = True

    _initialized = False

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, stylometric_features=None, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size=768)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size=768)

        # Process stylometric features if provided
        if stylometric_features is not None:
            if not self._initialized:
                self.initialize_stylometric_encoder(stylometric_features.size(1))
            stylo_emb = self.stylometric_encoder(stylometric_features)  # (batch, 16)
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, stylo_emb], dim=1)  # (batch, 768+16=784)
        else:
            # Pad with zeros if no stylometric features
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, torch.zeros(pooled.size(0), 16, device=pooled.device)], dim=1)

        if return_embeddings:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            features = combined
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            return logits

class TextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, augment=False):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels

        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        if self.augment:
            text = augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.05, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05)
        encoded = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=256,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": encoded["input_ids"].squeeze(0),
            "attention_mask": encoded["attention_mask"].squeeze(0),
            "idx": idx,  # Add index for mapping to stylometric features
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",
            "on",
            "nt",
            "ha",
            "ou",
            "it",
            "hi",

            "ed",
            "te",
            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),
            ("this", "was"),
        ]
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            bigram = (words[i], words[i + 1])
            if bigram in common_bigrams:
                count += 1
        return count / max(len(words), 1)

    "beautiful": ["lovely", "pretty", "gorgeous", "stunning", "attractive"],
    "strange": ["odd", "weird", "peculiar", "bizarre", "curious"],
}

def augment_text(text, word_dropout_prob=0.05, synonym_replace_prob=0.05, word_swap_prob=0.1, punct_insert_prob=0.15, vowel_noise_prob=0.05):
    """Apply enhanced augmentation: one of four augmentation types chosen randomly with equal probability."""
    # Choose exactly one augmentation randomly with equal probability (0.25 each)
    aug_choice = random.random()
    if aug_choice < 0.25:
        # (a) Random word swaps within 3-word windows
        words = str(text).split()
        if len(words) > 2:
            for i in range(len(words) - 1):
                if random.random() < word_swap_prob:
                    swap_window = min(3, len(words) - i)
                    swap_idx = i + random.randint(1, swap_window - 1)
                    words[i], words[swap_idx] = words[swap_idx], words[i]
        return " ".join(words)
    elif aug_choice < 0.50:
        # (b) Random insertion of punctuation at sentence boundaries
        text_str = str(text)
        sentences = re.split(r'(\. )', text_str)
        if len(sentences) > 1:
            punct_choices = ['--', ';', ':', '...']
            result_parts = []
            for sent in sentences:
                if random.random() < punct_insert_prob and sent.strip():
                    punct = random.choice(punct_choices)
                    result_parts.append(sent.rstrip() + ' ' + punct + ' ')
                else:
                    result_parts.append(sent)
            return ''.join(result_parts)
        else:
            return text_str
    elif aug_choice < 0.75:
        # (c) Character-level noise: randomly replace vowels with other vowels
        text_str = str(text)
        vowel_list = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']
        result_chars = []
        for ch in text_str:
            if ch.lower() in 'aeiou' and random.random() < vowel_noise_prob:
                new_vowel = random.choice([v for v in vowel_list if v != ch.lower()])
                if ch.isupper():
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel.upper())
                else:
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel)
            else:
                result_chars.append(ch)
        return ''.join(result_chars)
    else:
        # (d) Word dropout and enhanced synonym replacement
        words = str(text).split()
        augmented_words = []
        for word in words:
            if random.random() < word_dropout_prob:
                continue
            if random.random() < synonym_replace_prob and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
                replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
                if word[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                augmented_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                augmented_words.append(word)
        return " ".join(augmented_words)

# TEXT ENCODER (DistilBERT) with Attention Pooling
# ============================================================
class TextFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name="distilbert-base-uncased",
        hidden_dim=512,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.4,
        stylometric_dim=41,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.distilbert = DistilBertModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        config = self.distilbert.config
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim

        # Multi-head attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.hidden_size,
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=0.1,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        # Parallel stylometric encoder: 3-layer MLP (stylometric_dim→64→32→16)
        # Will be properly initialized later when we know stylometric_dim
        self.stylometric_dim = stylometric_dim
        self.stylometric_encoder = None

        # Classifier takes BERT pooled (768) + stylometric (16) = 784
        combined_dim = self.hidden_size + 16
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(combined_dim, self.hidden_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_classes),
        )

    def freeze_bert_except_top_n(self, n_layers_to_unfreeze=0):
        """Freeze all DistilBERT layers except the top n layers."""
        # First freeze everything
        for param in self.distilbert.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        # Unfreeze top n layers (transformer layers are in reverse order in distilbert)
        if n_layers_to_unfreeze > 0:
            layers = self.distilbert.transformer.layer
            total_layers = len(layers)
            for i in range(total_layers - n_layers_to_unfreeze, total_layers):
                for param in layers[i].parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True

    def initialize_stylometric_encoder(self, stylometric_dim):
        """Initialize the stylometric encoder after knowing the correct dimension."""
        self.stylometric_dim = stylometric_dim
        self.stylometric_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(stylometric_dim, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 16),
        ).to(device)
        self._initialized = True

    _initialized = False

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, stylometric_features=None, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.distilbert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        last_hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size=768)

        # Attention-weighted pooling: use CLS token as query
        cls_token = last_hidden[:, 0:1, :]  # (batch, 1, hidden_size)
        # Apply multi-head attention
        attn_output, attn_weights = self.attention(
            query=cls_token,
            key=last_hidden,
            value=last_hidden,
            key_padding_mask=~(attention_mask.bool()),
        )
        attn_output = self.attention_norm(attn_output + cls_token)
        attn_output = self.attention_dropout(attn_output)
        pooled = attn_output.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size=768)

        # Process stylometric features if provided
        if stylometric_features is not None:
            if not self._initialized:
                self.initialize_stylometric_encoder(stylometric_features.size(1))
            stylo_emb = self.stylometric_encoder(stylometric_features)  # (batch, 16)
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, stylo_emb], dim=1)  # (batch, 768+16=784)
        else:
            # Pad with zeros if no stylometric features
            combined = torch.cat([pooled, torch.zeros(pooled.size(0), 16, device=pooled.device)], dim=1)

        if return_embeddings:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            features = combined
            return logits, features
        else:
            logits = self.classifier(combined)
            return logits

def unfreeze_next_layers(optimizer, text_encoder, num_layers_to_unfreeze=4):
    """Unfreeze top num_layers_to_unfreeze DistilBERT layers and add them as a new param group."""
    total_layers = len(text_encoder.distilbert.transformer.layer)
    # Calculate which layers to unfreeze (top layers)
    frozen_layers = []
    for i, layer in enumerate(text_encoder.distilbert.transformer.layer):
        if not any(p.requires_grad for p in layer.parameters()):
            frozen_layers.append(i)
    # Unfreeze the topmost frozen layers
    layers_to_unfreeze = frozen_layers[-num_layers_to_unfreeze:] if len(frozen_layers) >= num_layers_to_unfreeze else frozen_layers
    for idx in layers_to_unfreeze:
        for param in text_encoder.distilbert.transformer.layer[idx].parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
    # Add new param group for unfrozen layers with lr=5e-5
    # Collect newly unfrozen parameters
    new_params = []
    for idx in layers_to_unfreeze:
        for param in text_encoder.distilbert.transformer.layer[idx].parameters():
            new_params.append(param)
    if new_params:
        optimizer.add_param_group({'params': new_params, 'lr': 5e-5})
    return optimizer

nodes.code_summary: The code performs authorship attribution on text data with three classes (EAP, HPL, MWS). It engineers 39+ stylometric features (character counts, punctuation stats, readability metrics, archaic word indicators, sentiment ratios, etc.), applies StandardScaler, and trains XGBoost and LightGBM baselines on these tabular features. The main model is a DistilBERT-based architecture with multi-head attention pooling and a parallel 3-layer stylometric encoder (64→32→16 dim), concatenating BERT embeddings (768) with stylometric features (16) before a 3-layer classifier. Training uses full fine-tuning with AdamW (differential learning rates), cosine annealing warm restarts, mixed precision (GradScaler), label smoothing (0.1), and text augmentation (word swaps, punctuation insertion, vowel noise, synonym replacement). Validation uses a stratified 5-fold split (first fold only), with early stopping (patience=3) monitoring validation loss.

def extract_features(text_series, is_train=True):
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=text_series.index)

    # Basic text stats

    features["word_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: len(str(x).split()))
    features["sent_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: len(re.split(r"[.!?]+", str(x))) - 1
    )
    features["avg_word_len"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: (
            np.mean([len(w) for w in str(x).split()]) if len(str(x).split()) > 0 else 0
        )
    )

    # Punctuation features
    features["excl_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("!"))
    features["quest_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("?"))
    features["period_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("."))
    features["comma_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count(","))
    features["semi_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count(";"))
    features["colon_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count(":"))
    features["quote_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: str(x).count('"') + str(x).count("'")
    )
    features["dash_count"] = text_series.apply(lambda x: str(x).count("-"))

    # Caps and special patterns
    features["caps_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in str(x) if c.isupper())
    )
    features["caps_ratio"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in str(x) if c.isupper()) / max(len(str(x)), 1)
    )
    features["digit_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in str(x) if c.isdigit())
    )

    # Readability features
    features["syllable_est"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(
            1
            for w in str(x).split()
            for c in ["a", "e", "i", "o", "u", "y"]
            if c in w.lower()
        )
    )
    features["complex_words"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).split() if len(w) > 6)
    )

    # Quote density
    features["quote_density"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: str(x).count('"') / max(len(str(x)), 1)
    )

    # Stopword-based features
    stopwords = {
        "the",
        "a",
        "an",
        "and",
        "or",
        "but",
        "in",
        "on",
        "at",

    features["stopword_ratio"] = features["stopword_count"] / features[
        "word_count"
    ].replace(0, 1)

    # Word length distribution

        "word_count"
    ].replace(0, 1)
    features["short_word_ratio"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in str(x).split() if len(w) <= 3)

    # Vocabulary diversity
    features["unique_words"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: len(set(str(x).lower().split()))
    )
    features["type_token_ratio"] = features["unique_words"] / features[

    ].replace(0, 1)

    # Historical/archaic word indicators

# N-gram features
def create_ngram_count(text, n=2, ngram_type="char"):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z\s]", "", text)
    if ngram_type == "char":
        common_ngrams = [
            "th",
            "he",
            "in",
            "er",
            "an",
            "re",
            "nd",
            "at",
            "on",
            "nt",
            "ha",
            "ou",

            "te",
            "ar",
            "al",
            "le",
            "ve",
            "ti",
            "ra",
            "ur",
            "me",
        ]
        return sum(text.count(ng) for ng in common_ngrams) / max(len(text), 1)
    else:
        words = text.split()
        common_bigrams = [
            ("of", "the"),
            ("in", "the"),
            ("to", "the"),
            ("and", "the"),
            ("it", "was"),
            ("i", "was"),
            ("there", "was"),

        count = 0

            if bigram in common_bigrams:

        return count / max(len(words), 1)

def augment_text(text):
    """Apply enhanced augmentation: exactly one of four augmentation types chosen randomly with equal probability.
    (a) Random word swaps within 3-word windows at 10% probability.
    (b) Random insertion of punctuation ('--', ';', ':', '...') at sentence boundaries at 15% probability.
    (c) Character-level vowel noise: replace 5% of vowels with other vowels.
    (d) Enhanced synonym replacement at 5% probability (with no word dropout).
    """
    # Choose exactly one augmentation randomly with equal probability (0.25 each)
    aug_choice = random.random()
    if aug_choice < 0.25:
        # (a) Random word swaps within 3-word windows at 10% probability
        words = str(text).split()
        if len(words) > 2:
            for i in range(len(words) - 1):
                if random.random() < 0.10:
                    swap_window = min(3, len(words) - i)
                    swap_idx = i + random.randint(1, swap_window - 1)
                    words[i], words[swap_idx] = words[swap_idx], words[i]
        return " ".join(words)
    elif aug_choice < 0.50:
        # (b) Random insertion of punctuation at sentence boundaries at 15% probability
        text_str = str(text)
        sentences = re.split(r'(\. )', text_str)
        punct_choices = ['--', ';', ':', '...']
        result_parts = []
        for sent in sentences:
            if random.random() < 0.15 and sent.strip():
                punct = random.choice(punct_choices)
                result_parts.append(sent.rstrip() + ' ' + punct + ' ')
            else:
                result_parts.append(sent)
        return ''.join(result_parts)
    elif aug_choice < 0.75:
        # (c) Character-level noise: replace 5% of vowels with other vowels
        text_str = str(text)
        vowel_list = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u']
        result_chars = []
        for ch in text_str:
            if ch.lower() in 'aeiou' and random.random() < 0.05:
                new_vowel = random.choice([v for v in vowel_list if v != ch.lower()])
                if ch.isupper():
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel.upper())
                else:
                    result_chars.append(new_vowel)
            else:
                result_chars.append(ch)
        return ''.join(result_chars)
    else:
        # (d) Enhanced synonym replacement at 5% probability (no word dropout)
        words = str(text).split()
        augmented_words = []
        for word in words:
            if random.random() < 0.05 and word.lower() in SYNONYM_MAP:
                replacement = random.choice(SYNONYM_MAP[word.lower()])
                if word[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                augmented_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                augmented_words.append(word)
        return " ".join(augmented_words)
